import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set up the figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette for fraud status
fraud_palette = {0: '#2ecc71', 1: '#e74c3c'}
fraud_labels = {0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'}

# Plot 1: Distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for fraud_status in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['is_fraud'] == fraud_status]
    ax1.hist(subset['amount'], bins=30, alpha=0.6, 
             label=fraud_labels[fraud_status], color=fraud_palette[fraud_status])
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Fraud count by transaction type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby(['transaction_type', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
fraud_by_type.columns = [fraud_labels[col] for col in fraud_by_type.columns]
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Count by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(title='Status')
ax2.set_xticklabels(ax2.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 3: Fraud rate by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'] = hourly_fraud['sum'] / hourly_fraud['count'] * 100
ax3.bar(hourly_fraud.index, hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], color='#3498db', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.axhline(y=df['is_fraud'].mean() * 100, color='#e74c3c', linestyle='--', 
            label=f'Overall Fraud Rate ({df["is_fraud"].mean()*100:.1f}%)')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24))
ax3.legend()
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Box plot of transaction amounts by type and fraud status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_status'] = df['is_fraud'].map(fraud_labels)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_status', 
            ax=ax4, palette={'Legitimate': '#2ecc71', 'Fraud': '#e74c3c'})
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(title='Status')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.93)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
